requirementsKey.network: Sandbox can download public data and npm packages
requirementsKey.supabase: Local Supabase running (supabase start) and .env.local has its URL and keys
requirementsKey.stripe: Stripe test-mode keys in .env.local and Stripe CLI logged in for webhook forwarding

tasks.title: Scaffold and PWA shell
tasks.acceptance: Next.js + TS strict + Tailwind builds; npm scripts for typecheck, lint, test (Vitest), e2e (Playwright) with one passing sample of each; PWA manifest (name 'Clout City: NYC', short name 'Clout City'), icons, installable, locked mobile viewport, bottom tab layout correct at 390px.

tasks.title: Data, copy, and store
tasks.acceptance: /data folders for items, premium, events, jobs, venues, landmarks, geo, config, and copy, each validated by a schema (zod or equivalent) with a test; central copy file with slang-pack layer (test proves swapping the pack changes rendered text); Zustand store with localStorage persistence and schema version (test for persist and rehydrate).

tasks.title: Core engine
tasks.acceptance: Pure-function game clock (1 real min = 10 game min of passive time, pauses when tab hidden, 1x/2x toggle); actions fast-forward the clock instantly by their duration; energy, hunger, mood decay with penalties at zero; action system with time, money, energy costs and stat effects validated in the engine; save/load with a schema migration test; unit tests for time math, action fast-forward, day and week rollover, insufficient funds.

tasks.title: Real NYC map
tasks.acceptance: Simplified real geography (five borough outlines, water, major parks, subway lines) preprocessed into /data/geo from public sources by a reproducible script in /scripts, with sources and licenses in /data/geo/SOURCES.md; rendered as a stylized sticker-style map with no third-party tile service and no Google Maps; pan and pinch-zoom bounded to NYC; points placed by real latitude and longitude are tappable; total geo payload under 300 KB gzipped; map works offline after first load; required attribution visible; unit test proves known coordinates land inside the correct borough shape; Playwright test pans the map and taps a point.

tasks.title: Guest start on the map
tasks.acceptance: Opening the root URL in a fresh browser shows the playable NYC map, centered on the player's Queens start, within 3 seconds locally with no signup; anonymous Supabase auth with a local-only fallback when env vars are missing (test runs with env vars absent); HUD with stats, clock, money, clout, and the goal line 'Make it in New York'; page title and meta use the tagline 'Tap In. Blow Up.'; Playwright test confirms.

tasks.title: Guided first action
tasks.acceptance: A 20-second guided prompt on the map leads the player through a first bodega purchase near their Queens start with no tutorial screens and no age check; Playwright test completes it.

tasks.title: Boroughs, landmarks, and venues
tasks.acceptance: Five boroughs in data. Queens, Brooklyn, and Manhattan each have 8 invented venues with original names at plausible real coordinates (bodega, food spot, subway station, park or gym, coffee shop, thrift or boutique, club, job site). Landmarks at real coordinates with category, nameMode, and legalReviewed:false, at minimum: Brooklyn Bridge, Manhattan Bridge, Queensboro Bridge; Flatiron Building, Chrysler Building; Statue of Liberty (viewed from Battery Park), Washington Square Arch; Central Park, the High Line, Prospect Park, Flushing Meadows (Unisphere), Astoria Park; the Queens ballpark and the Brooklyn arena (generic labels); City Hall, Brooklyn Borough Hall, Queens Borough Hall; Grand Central, Penn Station, Jamaica Station; Times Square, DUMBO, Coney Island boardwalk, Flushing Main Street; 9/11 Memorial (memorial category). Bronx and Staten Island are locked 'expanding soon' tiles teasing the Bronx ballpark and the Staten Island Ferry. Brooklyn and Manhattan unlock by clout level. Validation tests: every landmark has a category and nameMode; branded names use generic labels; memorials have no flex, clout, or event hooks. Gating tests.

tasks.title: Transit and rush hour
tasks.acceptance: Walk, subway, and taxi with time and cost computed from real distances between points, per-mode speeds and fares in config; subway trips route via the nearest stations on the real lines in /data/geo, with walking legs at each end; travel fast-forwards the clock; rush hour (7-10am, 4-7pm) slows subway and drains mood; random MTA delay event hook; no MTA logos or official line bullets; unit tests for distance, routing, and modifiers.

tasks.title: Location action sheet, club door, landmark visits
tasks.acceptance: Tapping a venue or landmark opens an action sheet filtered by time of day and opening hours; closed venues show opening time; the club opens at night with a cover charge, a minimum clout level at the door, and a clout gain inside; non-memorial landmarks have a Visit action (time cost, mood gain) and a flexMultiplier from config for use by S13; memorials show a respectful info card only; tests.

tasks.title: Items, inventory, and shop
tasks.acceptance: 12 clothing and makeup items across 3 rarity tiers and 5 slots plus 3 gift types, all with currency 'cash', price, rarity, sellValue, cloutValue, statEffects; gifts are consumed when used on NPCs or yourself and cannot target another player; inventory and outfit equip; buy and sell with depreciation; schema validation and unit tests including insufficient funds.

tasks.title: Jobs and rent
tasks.acceptance: Four jobs per CLAUDE.md anchors (barista, retail, delivery with higher energy cost, junior dev gated by clout level) with 4-hour shifts that fast-forward the clock; rent due every 7 game days; missed rent escalates to eviction and a move to cheaper housing; unit tests.

tasks.title: Economy simulation test
tasks.acceptance: A scripted bot plays 30 game days solo with a sensible strategy and ends neither bankrupt nor wildly rich (bounds in test); it saves roughly $150 per week and reaches the first apartment upgrade affordability between game days 10 and 14; any cost tuning needed to hit this is done in /data/config and logged; test fails if balance drifts.

tasks.title: Clout, style, flex, levels
tasks.acceptance: Integer clout from item cloutValue (counts only while owned or equipped; a buy/sell loop cannot farm clout, proven by test), first paycheck, and a flex action with seeded-random viral chance weighted by outfit style score and the landmark flexMultiplier when flexing at a landmark; style score multiplies clout gains; six levels (Nobody, Local, Scene Regular, Known, Famous, Icon) in config with HUD progress; a level-up event is emitted; the clout calculation tags each source by currency so premium items (S25) plug in and can be capped without engine changes; unit tests.

tasks.title: Events
tasks.acceptance: Data-driven event engine with conditions (time, borough, location, stats, clout, items), weights, and choice outcomes; modal UI; 15 events in the voice of CLAUDE.md including MTA delay, rent hike, free pizza, club promoter offer, viral moment, 2 mild crime events, and at least 2 landmark-tied events; validation test proves no event can fire at a memorial and no crime event can fire at a government building; seeded-random tests.

tasks.title: Goals, Icon moment, prestige
tasks.acceptance: Goals screen (first paycheck, first outfit, first landmark visit, first club night, first friend, level thresholds) with rewards and progress; reaching Icon shows a victory screen with a share hook and a prestige option (restart progress, keep cosmetics and premium items, earn a prestige badge; rules in config); tests.

tasks.title: Apartment and decor
tasks.acceptance: One apartment upgrade (Queens room to Brooklyn 1BR) with higher rent and more slots; 6 decor items across rarity tiers placed in slots via tap; home score feeds clout; Playwright test places an item.

tasks.title: Age gate
tasks.acceptance: Age check appears before the first chat message, friend request, invite or share, or real-money purchase; it never appears before solo play or in-game cash purchases (test proves the S06 bodega flow has no age check); under-13 gets solo play with chat, all other social features, and real-money purchases blocked; 13-17 sees a parental-consent notice before any real-money purchase; unit and Playwright tests.

tasks.title: Core schema and RLS
tasks.acceptance: Migrations for profiles, saves, friendships, friend_boosts, roommates, referrals, live_stats, purchases, and entitlements, all with Row Level Security; purchases and entitlements are readable only by their owner and writable only by the service role; a profile row is created on first guest session; a server-side function enforces one friend boost per sender per day; tests prove users cannot read or write others' private rows.

tasks.title: Account upgrade keeps progress
tasks.acceptance: After the first milestone the player is prompted to save progress via email magic link or Google; all guest progress carries over; Playwright test completes the magic-link flow using the local Supabase mail catcher; the Google button is present and its manual check is listed under Needs human review.

tasks.title: Invite link and friends
tasks.acceptance: Unique invite link with native share sheet (after the age check); opening it lands on the map first with the referrer stored in the background; friend list with send, accept, decline, report, and block; friend prompts appear after first paycheck, first level-up, and first outfit purchase, capped per session; persistent 'Add friends' HUD button; no contact scraping; tests.

tasks.title: Friends-only chat with a fixed daily limit
tasks.acceptance: One-to-one text chat between accepted friends only, after the age check; under-13 players cannot chat; migrations for messages and chat_quota with Row Level Security (users read only conversations they are part of; no client writes to chat_quota); a server-side function sends a message and decrements quota atomically, allowing 10 text messages per player per day with a New York midnight reset and 140 characters max; the limit of 10 is read from config, applies to every player, and no purchase, reward, goal, referral, or age tier can raise it; messages containing links, images, phone numbers, emails, or social handles are rejected server-side and do not use quota; unlimited emoji reactions and preset quick-replies that do not count toward the limit; a visible 'N of 10 left today' counter and an in-voice message when the limit is reached, with time until reset; report and block on every chat, and blocking hides the conversation both ways; tests prove the 11th message is refused, concurrent sends cannot exceed the limit, rejected messages keep quota, the reset happens at New York midnight, and users cannot read others' conversations.

tasks.title: Friend advantage
tasks.acceptance: A friend can send one daily boost (energy plus small clout) per day and the sender gets a small reward, enforced server-side; each friend adds a capped clout-gain bonus; two friends can link as roommates at the same apartment tier and each pays a config percentage of rent, with no cash moving between players and the link enforced server-side; the S12 solo bot still meets its targets with zero friends; tests.

tasks.title: Share cards and deep links
tasks.acceptance: Branded 9:16 share cards via OG routes (footer 'Tap In. Blow Up. | Clout City: NYC') for level-up, borough move, viral flex, and landmark flex (landmark drawn in game art style, never photos; never for memorials); share links open a landing preview with one-tap 'Start your NYC story' that lands on the map with the referrer attached; snapshot and Playwright tests.

tasks.title: Referral reward
tasks.acceptance: When an invitee reaches their first paycheck, inviter and invitee each receive a referral-exclusive cosmetic item; one reward per account or device; enforced server-side; fraud cases tested (self-invite, repeat device, reward replay).

tasks.title: Live stats page
tasks.acceptance: Cached aggregate counters (players online from a 2-minute heartbeat sample, total players, visits today, visits all time) refreshed every 30 seconds with no per-viewer DB query; public /live page 'How New York is growing, live' with LIVE badge, 'updated Ns ago', and OG image; 'Post these numbers' button opens a pre-filled X post with tagline and referral-tagged link; no personal data exposed; tests.

tasks.title: Premium catalog and clout rules
tasks.acceptance: /data/premium holds at least 8 premium items (outfits, apartment themes, profile badges, share-card frames) across rarity tiers, each with currency 'usd', a price tier from config, cloutValue, and styleValue; premium items cannot be bought or sold for in-game cash, have no sellValue, and cannot be transferred; total clout from premium items is capped by premiumCloutCap in config; premium store screen shows clear USD prices and owned state (purchase button wired in S26); S12 simulation extended so a bot owning every premium item stays within balance bounds and cannot reach Icon on premium clout alone; tests.

tasks.title: Stripe Checkout and entitlements
tasks.acceptance: Stripe Checkout in test mode only; buying requires a saved account (guests are prompted to save progress first); age gate before checkout, 13-17 parental-consent notice, under-13 blocked; the Checkout session is created server-side from catalog prices (the client never sends a price); the webhook verifies signatures and writes purchases and entitlements idempotently (duplicate-webhook test); entitlements restore on sign-in on any device; a refund webhook revokes the entitlement and its clout; tests using Stripe CLI fixtures.

tasks.title: Copy and brand pass
tasks.acceptance: All player-facing text comes from the copy file with the slang pack applied to events, goals, prompts, chat quick-replies and limit messages, landmarks, and share cards; welcome line and tagline present; placeholder Terms, Privacy, and Purchases and Refunds pages with a TODO for legal review; map data attribution shown in the app and on a credits page.

tasks.title: Polish, smoke test, deploy readiness
tasks.acceptance: Loading, empty, and error states on every screen; offline solo play works; first load including the map under about 3 seconds on throttled 4G; README covers setup, env vars, local Supabase, Stripe CLI, data sources, adding items, premium items, events, venues, landmarks, and copy, and Vercel deploy steps (the deploy itself is a human step); end-to-end smoke test passes: open link, land on map, first action, visit a landmark, buy item, level up, share card.
